verdict.rationale: Kling's homepage describes a built-in Agent that users brainstorm with and that writes scripts, generates images, videos and storyboards, and supports multi-round post-production refinement. Dedicated Skills generate assets in parallel, so the core of delegating tasks to an in-product assistant is documented. missing for 10: in-depth docs on the agent's autonomy, scope and task-handoff workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond marketing copy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Brainstorm with your Agent, write scripts, and generate images, videos, and storyboards—then refine and edit your videos through multiple rounds of post-production.
Use dedicated Skills to create storyboards, posters, e-commerce assets, and more—all generated in parallel.
Freely arrange and edit nodes at any time, while preserving your creative flow and context throughout
